Job Title: GenAI Engineer- Skills: GenAI, Typescript, Javascript, AWS
Experience: 4 8 years Location: Remote & India (Hybrid)- Job Locations: Gurgaon, Haryana, India; Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India; Bangalore, Karnataka, India
Role Overview
We are seeking a GenAI Engineer with strong hands-on experience in building, deploying, and scaling enterprise-grade Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in LLM internals, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and cloud-native microservices, with the ability to translate AI capabilities into secure, scalable enterprise applications.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop GenAI solutions leveraging AWS services such as Lambda, Managed Airflow (MWAA), Bedrock, S3, and DynamoDB.
Build and optimize RAG-based architectures using vector databases and advanced text processing techniques.
Work with LLMs and enterprise chat platforms including ChatGPT, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic (Claude), and Ollama.
Develop and maintain enterprise-level MCP servers and GenAI backend services.
Design and deploy containerized microservices using Docker and Kubernetes.
Integrate vector databases such as Weaviate for semantic search and knowledge retrieval.
Ensure scalability, security, observability, and compliance of GenAI solutions in enterprise environments.
Collaborate with architects, product teams, and stakeholders to align AI solutions with business use cases.
Provide technical guidance and contribute to architectural decisions for GenAI platforms.
Required Technical Skills
Strong understanding of AWS services: Lambda, Bedrock, MWAA (Managed Airflow), S3, DynamoDB.
In-depth knowledge of LLM internals, RAG architectures, vector databases, NLP, and text processing pipelines.
Hands-on experience with enterprise chat systems using ChatGPT, OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), and/or Ollama.
Experience building enterprise-scale MCP servers and AI middleware platforms.
Proficiency in Docker, Kubernetes, and microservices architecture.
Hands-on experience with vector databases such as Weaviate (or similar).
Strong programming experience in TypeScript / JavaScript.
Knowledge on building Chrome Extensions.
Good to Have
Experience with API gateways, authentication, and authorization in AI systems.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and MLOps practices for GenAI workloads.
Knowledge of observability tools for monitoring AI services and model performance.
Soft Skills
Strong problem-solving and system design skills.
Ability to explain complex GenAI concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Proactive learner with a strong ownership mindset.

jobs.job_description:
Location: Gurgaon
Work Mode: Hybrid
Experience: 4-7 Years
About Saarthee:
Saarthee is a Global Strategy, Analytics, Technology, and AI consulting company, where our passion for helping others fuels our approach, products, and solutions. Our diverse and global team works with one objective in mind - Our Customers Success. At Saarthee, we are passionate about guiding organizations towards insights-fueled success. That s why we call ourselves Saarthee inspired by the Sanskrit word Saarthi , which means charioteer, trusted guide, or companion. Cofounded in 2015 by Mrinal Prasad and Shikha Miglani, Saarthee already encompasses all the components of Data Analytics consulting. Saarthee is based out of Philadelphia, USA, with offices in the UK and India.
Position Summary:
We re expanding our Product and AI Innovation team and looking for a GenAI Engineers to lead the design and deployment of Generative AI solutions that power Saarthee s products and client platforms.
As a GenAI Engineer, you ll work on LLM-based architectures, prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, and GenAI-powered application development. You ll collaborate with product, data science, and engineering teams to integrate generative models into real-world business workflows driving automation, personalization, and decision intelligence.
This is a high-ownership role suited for innovators who love experimenting with the latest in AI and delivering production-grade solutions at scale.
Your Role Responsibilities and Duties:
Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI models and LLM-driven applications.
Work on prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, and custom LLM adaptation for domain-specific use cases.
Collaborate with Data Scientists and Engineers to integrate LLMs into analytics, automation, and workflow products.
Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems using vector databases and knowledge retrieval pipelines.
Develop and manage end-to-end GenAI pipelines from data preprocessing to inference and deployment.
Experiment with open-source and commercial LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Llama, etc.) and evaluate their applicability to product needs.
Create APIs and microservices that embed AI capabilities into products and enterprise systems.
Optimize model latency, cost, and performance in production environments.
Collaborate with product managers and designers to translate ideas into scalable, user-friendly GenAI applications.
Stay updated on emerging trends in Generative AI, NLP, and multimodal AI driving innovation within Saarthee s product ecosystem.
Required Skills and Qualifications:
Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related field.
4 7 years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering, with at least 1 2 years focused on Generative AI or LLM-based development.
Hands-on experience with Python and libraries/frameworks such as LangChain, Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI API, PyTorch, TensorFlow.
Practical knowledge of LLM fine-tuning, prompt design, and embedding models.
Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, Chroma) and RAG pipelines.
Familiarity with cloud services (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for model hosting and deployment.
Experience building APIs, chatbots, or GenAI-powered applications for enterprise use cases.
Strong understanding of NLP techniques, tokenization, and model evaluation metrics.
Proficiency in CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes is a plus.
Excellent problem-solving, experimentation, and communication skills.
A builder mindset, eager to innovate, prototype, and deliver high-impact AI solutions.
What We Offer:
Bootstrapped and financially stable with high pre-money evaluation.
Above-industry remunerations.
Additional compensation tied to Renewal and Pilot Project Execution.
Additional lucrative business development compensation.
Firm-building opportunities that offer a stage for holistic professional development, growth, and branding.
An empathetic, excellence-driven, and result-oriented organization that believes in mentoring and growing teams with a constant emphasis on learning.
